rationale: No existing Dashboards spec exercises the ECharts dataZoom brush->absolute-time path or GridStack panel drag->layout-persist path. The closest matches only touch chart-renderer for render/visual assertions (dashboard.spec.js, dashboard-config-advanced.spec.js), grid-stack-item for panel counting (dashboard-variables-panel-level.spec.js), and pie/donut for chart-type coverage (dashboard-pie-donut.spec.js). Neither zoom brush nor panel drag is covered, so a brand-new spec is required and must be registered in the Dashboards-Charts shard (playwright_group from run-context).
